Simultaneously acting forces; each has its own application point. Empty means no forces. Absent uses legacy force_n/application.

kind.description: Axis-aligned groups; u_shape opens towards +Y; l_shape has left and top edges (Gamma). Not normative GOST joint types.

origin_mm.description: Bounding-box centre, not the effective section centroid.

axis.description: Line through origin parallel to the specified global axis

copy_index.description: Optional zero-based source segment index. Copy only this segment with the specified transform, append it to unchanged originals and validate the combined group. Absent transforms the whole group.

SectionModel.description: Independent geometric idealization: 90-degree root, straight face, no credited penetration/concavity. No GOST compliance or strength rule.

MassLoad.description: Equivalent attachment load F=m(g-a), SI units. Global translational acceleration; no rotational inertia or inferred dynamic factors.

forces.description: Simultaneously acting forces; each has its own application point. Empty means no forces. Absent uses legacy force_n/application.

LoadCombination.description: Frozen source loads with explicit user factors; no live dependencies or normative combination rules. Editing loads must remove this provenance.

replace_case_id.description: Optional existing combination ID. Replaces factors/title from its frozen sources; terms must name every stored source exactly once. Other cases/results are retained. Does not read live source loads.

CustomProperty.description: Custom sourced value, thickness (min,max], temperature [min,max], no interpolation. Same-kind overlapping domains are rejected.

UserLimits.description: Explicit final user thresholds for independent nominal components, not normative acceptance. No material-derived values, interactions or local throat assessment.
